name: amphetamine-sessions
title: Amphetamine Sessions
description: Start, extend, and end Amphetamine keep-awake sessions from Raycast, with presets, natural durations, a menu bar timer, and app-based sessions.
author: fishux

commands.name: start-session
commands.title: Start Session
commands.subtitle: Amphetamine
commands.description: Keep your Mac awake for a duration like 45, 90m, 1h30m, or ∞.

commands.name: toggle-session
commands.title: Toggle Session
commands.subtitle: Amphetamine
commands.description: End the session if one is running, otherwise start one with your default duration. Ideal for a hotkey.

commands.name: manage-sessions
commands.title: Manage Sessions
commands.subtitle: Amphetamine
commands.description: See the current session, pick a preset, or type a duration or time to start one.

commands.name: keep-awake-until
commands.title: Keep Awake Until
commands.subtitle: Amphetamine
commands.description: Keep your Mac awake until a clock time like 17:30, 5pm, or noon.

commands.name: keep-awake-while-app
commands.title: Keep Awake While App Runs
commands.subtitle: Amphetamine
commands.description: Keep your Mac awake until the app you pick quits.

commands.name: extend-session
commands.title: Extend Session
commands.subtitle: Amphetamine
commands.description: Add time to the current session, keeping its display setting.

commands.name: session-status
commands.title: Session Status
commands.subtitle: Amphetamine
commands.description: Show whether a session is running and how long is left.

commands.name: toggle-display-sleep
commands.title: Toggle Display Sleep
commands.subtitle: Amphetamine
commands.description: Allow or prevent display sleep for the current session.

commands.name: toggle-closed-display
commands.title: Toggle Awake with Lid Closed
commands.subtitle: Amphetamine
commands.description: Allow or prevent closed-display mode, so the Mac stays awake with the lid shut.

commands.name: toggle-triggers
commands.title: Toggle Triggers
commands.subtitle: Amphetamine
commands.description: Turn Amphetamine's automatic Triggers (schedules, apps, Wi-Fi, and more) on or off.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Session Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Amphetamine
commands.description: Show the session countdown in the menu bar and stop sessions when the battery runs low.

preferences.name: showCountdown
preferences.title: Menu Bar Title
preferences.label: Show time remaining next to the icon
preferences.description: Show the session's remaining time in the menu bar.

preferences.name: hideWhenIdle
preferences.title: Idle State
preferences.label: Hide the icon when no session is running
preferences.description: Hide the menu bar item when no session is active.

preferences.name: lowBatteryThreshold
preferences.title: Low Battery Auto-Stop (%)
preferences.description: End the session when running on battery at or below this percentage. Leave blank to turn off.

tools.name: start-session
tools.title: Start Session
tools.description: Start an Amphetamine session that keeps the Mac awake for a number of minutes, indefinitely, or until a clock time.

tools.name: end-session
tools.title: End Session
tools.description: End the current Amphetamine session so the Mac can sleep normally.

tools.name: extend-session
tools.title: Extend Session
tools.description: Add minutes to the current Amphetamine session.

tools.name: get-session-status
tools.title: Get Session Status
tools.description: Report whether an Amphetamine session is running, how long is left, and its display, lid-closed, Trigger, and Drive Alive settings.

ai.instructions: Amphetamine keeps the Mac awake. Use start-session for requests like 'keep my Mac awake for 2 hours' or 'until 5pm'. Durations are in minutes; 0 means indefinitely. Only allow the display to sleep when the user asks for it.

evals.input: @amphetamine-sessions keep my mac awake for 90 minutes
@amphetamine-sessions how long until my mac can sleep?

preferences.name: defaultDuration
preferences.title: Default Duration
preferences.description: Used when no duration is given, e.g. 1h, 45, or ∞. Leave blank to use Amphetamine's own default.

preferences.name: defaultDisplay
preferences.title: Default Display Behavior
preferences.description: Whether new sessions keep the display on or let it sleep while the Mac stays awake. By default this follows Amphetamine's own Allow Display Sleep setting.

preferences.name: presets
preferences.title: Presets
preferences.description: Comma-separated durations shown in Manage Sessions and the menu bar.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
